findings.body: If an unsigned prototype PR contains the accepted sign-off and `merge = "human"`, `forge merge` can merge it but fail while deleting the remote branch or removing the worktree. On retry, this check sees sign-off on the default branch and refuses before reaching the existing cleanup path (`src/forge/merge.py:92-124`). The merged item is left without a usable Forge cleanup command.
findings.title: Allow merge cleanup after the sign-off PR lands

findings.body: The changed plan assigns this to TALK after MERGE. `src/forge/nextstep.py:304,317` still reads the raw merge setting, so an unsigned client prototype configured with `merge = "human"` is described as waiting for a human merge, including on the cleanup path. `src/forge/templates/skill.md:41-43` likewise instructs the agent to run `forge merge` only when the raw setting is `agent`. TALK must use the effective setting and test those command paths.
findings.title: Later: TALK must update forge next and agent guidance

findings.body: Done-when item 1 calls for an accepted decision recording the owner's choice. This branch adds the merge override but no such decision under `docs/decisions/`. The changed Tasks table assigns that record and its checklist test to SPEC.
findings.title: Later: SPEC must record the owner's merge decision
